assessments.quote: our study proposes a novel 2D segmentation method based on the nnUNet framework, enhanced with MedSAM/MedSAM2 features
assessments.reason: Uses nnU-Net as baseline and MedSAM/MedSAM2 as feature extractor, reporting Dice/HD95 differences, but it is a fusion application rather than a systematic comparison of the two methods' differences.

assessments.quote: This paper evaluates the performance of segmentation foundation models (FMs), including Segment Anything Model (SAM), MedSAM, and UniverSeg, against traditional supervised learning (with nnU-net) for lymphoma segmentation
assessments.reason: Head-to-head evaluation of MedSAM versus nnU-Net on clinical MRI, reporting that supervised nnU-Net outperformed foundation models, directly evidencing performance differences.

assessments.quote: This study compares three methods for 2D bone metastasis segmentation on computed tomography slices-the self-configuring nnU-Net pipeline, a fine-tuned DINOv3 foundation model, and a prompt-free MedSAM foundation model adaptation
assessments.reason: Direct comparison of MedSAM and nnU-Net under comparable conditions with Dice and NHD metrics, quantifying performance differences on CT lesion segmentation.

assessments.quote: we present a novel approach which integrates self-configuring segmentation frameworks (nnU-net) with generalized foundation models (MedSAM)
assessments.reason: Reports that the integrated MedSAM-nnU-Net model improved over MedSAM and nnU-Net individually, giving indirect comparative evidence but focused on a fusion method rather than characterizing differences.

assessments.quote: An nnU-Net model was trained from scratch to serve as a benchmark and to provide bounding box prompts for MedSAM.
assessments.reason: Evaluates off-the-shelf MedSAM against an nnU-Net benchmark on pelvic MRI, showing MedSAM's poor out-of-box performance and need for fine-tuning, directly evidencing differences.

assessments.quote: two contemporary segmentation frameworks, nnU-Net v2 and MedSAM
assessments.reason: Trains and evaluates nnU-Net and MedSAM on cardiac MRE, comparing Dice across configurations and showing MedSAM needs semi-automated fine-tuning to match nnU-Net.

assessments.quote: This research uses Segment Anything Model (SAM), Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2), MedSAM, SAM-Med-3D, and nnU-Net to obtain zero-shot inference on the BraTS 2023
assessments.reason: Benchmarks MedSAM and nnU-Net across prompt qualities on BraTS, discussing prompt dependence versus nnU-Net's dominance, directly evidencing differences.

assessments.quote: It includes: MedSAM zero-shot and MedSAM+LoRA adapters; crop-guided and prompt-matched nnU-Net export
assessments.reason: Software release description mentioning both MedSAM and nnU-Net components but no comparative results or analysis of differences in the abstract.

assessments.quote: we integrate an SPCA utilizing the MedSAM foundation model to incorporate spatial prior information of the lung region
assessments.reason: Uses MedSAM as a prior generator within an nnU-Net pipeline and compares to standard nnU-Net, but does not compare MedSAM and nnU-Net as segmentation methods.

assessments.quote: We evaluated SAM-Med3D for ESCC lesion segmentation and compared it with state-of-the-art methods including nnU-Net, SegVol, and MedSAM.
assessments.reason: Reports Dice/HD95 for nnU-Net and MedSAM as baselines in a comparison, providing some comparative evidence but centered on SAM-Med3D rather than the MedSAM vs nnU-Net distinction.

assessments.quote: Tumor multi-region segmentation was conducted using nnU-Net
assessments.reason: nnU-Net is used only as a preprocessing segmentation tool for a glioma subtype prediction model; MedSAM is absent and no method comparison is made.
